learning_outcomes.text: Students who have successfully completed this module can describe the professional and interdisciplinary demands that the course of study and the later profession place on them. They can name specific aspects of the respective disciplinary culture and provide a content overview of the subject area.

Students who have successfully completed this module can link their existing general, abstract, and theoretical knowledge about the course of study and the respective subject area with the specific, concrete, and practical impressions gained in this module.

Students who have successfully completed this module master fundamental and important modes of action for successfully managing their studies and are able to successfully collaborate in groups to achieve good solutions within the framework of exercises and small projects and to present and justify them to others.

Graduates of the module are able to integrate the acquired learning competences as well as the insights into studies and profession into an individual study goal and align their further studies accordingly.

syllabus_topics: Thematic introduction to the degree program
Information acquisition, reception, and production of texts
assessment_rules: To receive ECTS credits, students must complete either a term paper and project report (written) and regular participation, OR a presentation (with written elaboration) and project report (written) and regular participation. The written parts (term paper/project report or presentation elaboration) should be 5-10 pages. The presentation should be 10-15 minutes. Regular participation requires at least 80% attendance. Assessment can be done in group work.
